memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans. Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez. The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans - Josh 19:17-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The fourth lot falls to Issachar, with its towns spread across some of the most fertile farmland in Israel, including the rich Valley of Jezreel. Long before, Jacob had described Issachar as a strong donkey resting between two burdens, who saw that his resting place was good and bent his shoulder to the work (Gen 49:14-15). Issachar was to be a tribe of steady, hardworking farmers, content to labour in a good land.

There is honour in this quiet calling. Issachar would not be famous for dramatic exploits, but for faithful, steady work in the fields God had given them. Later, the men of Issachar would even be praised for understanding the times and knowing what Israel should do (1 Chron 12:32). Steady faithfulness and quiet wisdom — these were the marks of this tribe. Not everyone is called to the spotlight; some are called to bend their shoulder to good and necessary work.

This is an encouragement for the many whose lives are made up of steady, unglamorous faithfulness. The daily work, the ordinary labour, the quiet perseverance — these are not lesser callings in God's eyes. Issachar's inheritance of good farmland and hard work was a genuine gift and a genuine service. Whatever ordinary work God has given you, do it heartily as unto Him, for such steady faithfulness is precious in His sight (Col 3:23-24).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you undervalue your steady, unglamorous work?
- How does Issachar's honourable calling encourage you in your daily labour?
- What would it mean to bend your shoulder to your work as unto the Lord?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for the dignity of steady, faithful work. Help me to labour heartily as unto You, trusting that quiet faithfulness is precious in Your sight. Amen.
